cases.scenario_description: User claims 'Empty Box' for an iPhone. The shipping box is intact, but they carefully peeled the factory seal using a heat gun.
cases.legal_precedent: CPA 2019 Sec 2(47) - Unfair Trade Practice claims by consumer
cases.autonomous_resolution_action: Deny claim. Telemetry shows device was activated with user's iCloud ID 10 minutes prior to claim.

cases.scenario_description: Customer places an insect into a nearly finished ₹800 meal, snaps a photo, and claims instant refund.
cases.legal_precedent: CPA 2019 - Strict Liability vs. Malicious Intent
cases.autonomous_resolution_action: Reject full refund. Offer ₹100 wallet credit for inconvenience since meal was 90% consumed before reporting.
